scope: Maintained live OpenCode human inbox installation, read-only session-scoped notifications and automated TUI answer/review verification. The subsequent actual-human live test passed, recorded separately.
command: node src/cli.mjs native inbox install --here --context PRIVATE_OWNER_JSON --evidence-file PRIVATE_JSONL

tests.automatedRuntimeSmoke: OpenCode 2.1.2 backend, worker tools, daemon, keyboard human inbox and candidate review

liveTest.status: completed after direct actual-human TUI answer and review

limitations: Actual-human live decisions are recorded in native-human-inbox-live.json, separately from the automated smoke.
Human interaction uses keyboard dialogs with session/dialog provenance, not arbitrary natural-chat user-message authentication.
Automatic notifications appear only when the configured human session is selected. The durable inbox remains available from other authorised local TUIs.
This does not certify coordinator escalation, closed-origin recovery, crash replay or two physical machines.
